title.value: Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity
title.evidence_quote: Applications open for the 2027-28 Cohort of the Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity programme

institution.name: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), International Inequalities Institute

qualifications: Must meet LSE's English language requirements
Residential-track applicants must also qualify for the MSc in Inequalities and Social Science
Apply through LSE's Graduate Application System; incomplete applications are not considered
description_short: LSE's Atlantic Fellows for Social and Economic Equity programme is recruiting its 2027-28 cohort of practitioners with at least seven years' experience working on inequality. Applications close 11 January 2027 at 5pm UK time; late applications are not accepted.

deadline.evidence_quote: applications will close at 5.00pm GMT on 11 January 2027
